Hairy Henry is a member of the Cult of Myrkul in the sanctum north of the Barracks in the Mind Flayer Colony.
“
Heed the Mistress. She is blessed.
„
— Hairy Henry

Involvement

Henry is being rallied by  Kressa Bonedaughter along with his fellow cultists  Ironfinger and  Maghtew Budj. On approaching, Kressa casts  Myrkul's Gift, which gives her and the other cultists 10 temporary hitpoints.

Henry attacks along with the other followers in the barracks if combat is initiated through dialogue with Kressa or if he is attacked.

If left alone, he moves to his room in the south-western part of the barracks, greeting the party with "Heed the Mistress. She is blessed" and "Walk in shadow" if spoken to.
